name: libevent
description: Asynchronous event notification library providing a mechanism to execute callbacks when file descriptors, timers, or signals become ready, using the best available OS backend (epoll, kqueue, select, etc). Used by tmux, memcached, and Tor.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
